cause_quote: Adding `props.runStatus?.phase ?? ""` and `props.runStatus?.occurredAt ?? 0` to `trackTranscriptRenderDependencies` made status-only changes invalidate every guarded history row.
summary: The fix removes run status from the transcript's shared render dependencies so settled history stays cached when status appears, refreshes, or clears.
reasoning: The parent of #124301 already had composer run-status feedback and a transcript render guard whose dependencies excluded run status. #124301 added phase and timestamp to the shared guard, causing even a status change that left every message unchanged to rerender settled rows. #127823 moved the interruption row back to the composer and left both dependencies in place.
